title: Rubbish & recycling

questions.question: What do you do when you see rubbish on the street?
questions.sampleAnswer: What I usually do is pick it up if it’s easy, and put it in the nearest bin. I tend to do this because litter really bothers me, and small actions make a difference.

questions.question: How do you recycle things like paper and plastic?
questions.sampleAnswer: I usually separate them at home — paper in one bag and plastic in another — and take them to the recycling bins near my building. I tend to wash plastic bottles first so they’re clean.

questions.question: Is waste sorting common in your country?
questions.sampleAnswer: Generally speaking, yes, it’s becoming quite common, especially in big cities. Many communities now have different bins, and schools teach children how to sort waste. So I think it’s gradually becoming a habit.

questions.question: Did you recycle when you were a kid?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I remember I did a little. It was when I was in primary school, and the school taught us to collect paper and plastic for recycling. I felt it was a small way to help the environment.
